caseName: White v. Attorney Grievance Comm'n of Mich.
caseNameFull: Joseph WHITE, et ux. v. ATTORNEY GRIEVANCE COMMISSION OF MICHIGAN.

opinions.text: Motion of petitioners for leave to proceed in forma pauperis denied. Petitioners allowed until March 20, 2017, within *1220which to pay the docketing fee required by Rule 38(a) and to submit a petition in compliance with Rule 33.1 of the Rules of this Court.
